name: ArcadiaFi
fix_description: Add nonReentrant modifier to vaultManagementAction and related state-changing functions (borrow, withdraw). The executeAction external call occurs between _withdraw and _deposit, creating a window where vault state is inconsistent. An attacker can reenter borrow during this window when collateral appears intact but assets have already been withdrawn.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC requires understanding a protocol-specific vault/leverage flow, crafting multi-step interactions across factory, vaults, lending pools, multicall handler, and helper contracts, and exploiting a non-trivial reentrant liquidation state inconsistency. Even though the code is not extremely long, the attack chain is repeated across two assets and depends on deep knowledge of Arcadia’s internal accounting and execution ordering, which would likely take an experienced auditor over 2 hours to reconstruct.
